lines.text_source: Right, we're inside now.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Certo, estamos dentro agora.

lines.text_source: It seems to be a kind of laboratory...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Parece ser uma espécie de laboratório...

lines.text_source: What is Baydral up to?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: O que Baydral está fazendo?

lines.text_source: Chief! We should hurry!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Chefe! Devemos nos apressar!

lines.text_source: Yes... Human, this is for you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sim... Humano, isto é para você.

lines.text_source: It'll allow you to move around underwater without drowning. Don't bad, right?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Permite que você se mova debaixo d'água sem afogar. Não é ruim, não é?

lines.text_source: You're practically Fise now.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Você é praticamente um Fise agora.

lines.text_source: Chief, I have a question.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Chefe, tenho uma pergunta.

lines.text_source: Yes, Baiyu?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sim, Baiyu?

lines.text_source: Why have we made them take us all the way here if we haven't come across any underwater areas?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Por que os fizemos nos carregar até aqui se não encontramos áreas aquáticas?

lines.text_source: Baiyu... Please...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Baiyu... Por favor...

lines.text_source: No, seriously. What need was there for them to carry us? We can walk, too.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não, sério. Qual era a necessidade? A gente caminha também.

lines.text_source: Baiyu, there's a braj behind you!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Baiyu, há um braj atrás de você!

lines.text_source: I told you it'd be useful. Onwards, we can carry on now.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Avisei que seria útil. Vamos, podemos prosseguir.

lines.text_source: I'll try to find you later.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tentarei encontrá-lo depois.

lines.text_source: Good luck!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Boa sorte!

lines.text_source: Got it!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Entendido!

lines.text_source: Unfortunately, it looks like I still can't reach your position.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Infelizmente, parece que ainda não consigo chegar aonde você está.

lines.text_source: It's clear we'll need to continue on separate paths for a little while longer.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: É claro que vamos precisar seguir caminhos separados por um pouco mais.

lines.text_source: Good luck, soldier!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Boa sorte, soldado!

lines.text_source: That floodgate doesn't have a card reader... Will we be able to open it?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Esse comporta não tem leitor de cartão... Conseguimos abri-lo?

lines.text_source: Baiyu, let the important people speak.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Baiyu, deixe as pessoas importantes falar.

lines.text_source: (Why don't you just talk to yourself?)
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: (Por que não só conversa consigo mesmo?)

lines.text_source: I was referring to the soldierman here.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Referia-me ao soldado aqui.

lines.text_source: What do you think? It looks like that capsule contains something with several connections. Perhaps if we break it, it'll cause a system failure in the door.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: O que você acha? Parece que aquela cápsula contém algo com várias conexões. Talvez se quebrarmos, cause falha no sistema da porta.

lines.text_source: Break things... Seriously, chief?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Quebrar coisas... Sério mesmo, chefe?

lines.text_source: Go on, try it.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vai lá, tenta.

lines.text_source: Oh, bladderwrack! It didn't work...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Que alga-bexiga! Não funcionou...

lines.text_source: Wait, chief. You look different. And those hydrobubbles have appeared.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Espera, chefe. Você parece diferente. E aquelas hidro-bolhas apareceram.

lines.text_source: I was just about to mention that, of course.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Estava prestes a mencionar isso, é claro.

lines.text_source: Mister soldierman, you feel different, right? Try using that energy on the hydrobubbles. We'll find another way.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Soldado, você sente diferente, não é? Tente usar essa energia nas hidro-bolhas. Encontramos outro caminho.

lines.text_source: Come on Baiyu, don't linger.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vamos, Baiyu, não fique para trás.

lines.text_source: HA! I knew I'd find the toy first.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: HA! Sabia que achava aquele brinquedo primeiro.

lines.text_source: Sorry, sister, I don't plan on sharing it with you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Desculpe, irmã, não pretendo dividir com você.

lines.text_source: Damn it!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Maldição!

lines.text_source: I knew you wouldn't tell me! Selfish as usual!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sabia que não me contaria! Sempre egoísta!

lines.text_source: Always ruining my fun. I might just be tired of having a sister. You'll be next.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sempre arruinando minha diversão. Talvez eu só esteja cansado de ter uma irmã. Você será o próximo.
lines.risk_notes: Linguagem ofensiva; referência a violência contra familiar. Alto registro de risco.

lines.text_source: How dare you!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Como você ousa!

lines.text_source: If you hadn't been so meddling...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Se você não fosse tão intrometida...

lines.text_source: I wasn't going to let you go alone...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não ia deixar você ir sozinha...

lines.text_source: This place doesn't feel right...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Este lugar não tem boa aparência...

lines.text_source: Chief, it appears to be their main laboratory. Surely if we look at their research...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Chefe, parece ser o laboratório principal deles. Se olharmos a pesquisa deles...

lines.text_source: Tone down the chitchat, Baiyu. I say we should take a peak at Baydral's studies.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Diminua o bate-papo, Baiyu. Acho que devemos dar uma olhada nos estudos de Baydral.

lines.text_source: Chief, there are all sorts of things here, and all of it is beyond insanity.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Chefe, tem de tudo aqui, e tudo é loucura pura.

lines.text_source: Focus on what matters: the curse of the braj.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Foque no que importa: a maldição do braj.

lines.text_source: But our problem is nothing compared to his other plans.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mas nosso problema é nada perto dos outros planos dele.

lines.text_source: Baiyu, what are you talking about?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Baiyu, do que você está falando?

lines.text_source: Have you seen those murals? It look like he's trying to hybridise saltwater and freshwater Fise.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Viu aqueles murais? Parece que ele está tentando hibridizar Fise de água salgada e doce.

lines.text_source: I must say, it does look a bit sinister...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Devo dizer, realmente tem aparência um pouco sinistro...

lines.text_source: Is that Hafin Dam?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: É a Barragem de Hafin?

lines.text_source: What was that?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: O que foi isso?

lines.text_source: Is it Baydral? We've been to every part of his laboratory and he hasn't turned up anywhere.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: É Baydral? Visitamos cada parte do laboratório dele e ele não apareceu em lugar nenhum.

lines.text_source: Mister soldierman... Would you mind taking a look?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Soldado... Importaria de dar uma olhada?

lines.text_source: Shouldn't we go with him?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não devemos ir com ele?

lines.text_source: I think figuring out what's going on here is more important right now.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Acho que descobrir o que está acontecendo aqui é mais importante agora.

lines.text_source: Don't take your eye off those manuscripts.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não tire os olhos daqueles manuscritos.

lines.text_source: So, please, if it's Baydral, tell us.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Então, por favor, se é Baydral, nos diga.

lines.text_source: Meddlesome cretins!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Miserável chatos!

lines.text_source: You should stay in that beloved city of yours... While you still can...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Deveriam ficar naquela cidade querida... Enquanto ainda podem...
lines.risk_notes: Linguagem ameaçadora; referência a possível destruição. Verificar se spoiler.

lines.text_source: Did you think we Fise would spend the rest of our existence in a world like this?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Pensaram que nós Fise poderíamos passar a eternidade num mundo assim?
lines.risk_notes: Discurso ideológico sobre existência futura. Verificar contexto de spoiler.

lines.text_source: You're just an naive as I was in the past, but you'd best start forgetting about your feeble structures. Now it'll be you who will have to adapt to my world.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Você é tão ingênuo quanto eu era no passado, mas é melhor começar a esquecer suas estruturas frágeis. Agora será você quem terá que se adaptar ao meu mundo.
lines.risk_notes: worldbuilding reference (structures/world); ensure 'adapt to my world' conveys dominance without ambiguity

lines.text_source: Because soon there will be nothing but ruins under the raging storm of my revenge!
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Pois em breve não haverá nada além de ruínas sob a tempestade furiosa de minha vingança!
lines.risk_notes: spoiler-adjacent (revenge plot); 'raging storm' is metaphorical destruction

lines.text_source: Muahahahaha...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Muahahaha...

lines.text_source: Hello again, soldier.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Olá novamente, soldado.

lines.text_source: I was trying to help our friends find what they were looking for.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Estava tentando ajudar nossos amigos a encontrar o que procuravam.

lines.text_source: But I don't understand a word of these writing, to tell you the truth...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mas para ser honesto, não entendo uma palavra desses escritos.

lines.text_source: Of course, they're in Fise.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Claro, eles estão em Fise.

lines.text_source: It was Baydral, right?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Era Baydral, não era?

lines.text_source: He was there...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ele estava lá...

lines.text_source: Really? Will he help us? Where is here?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mesmo? Ele nos ajudará? Onde fica aqui?

lines.text_source: Baiyu, I don't think he's there anymore.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Baiyu, não acho que ele está mais lá.

lines.text_source: Really?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mesmo?

lines.text_source: Seriously?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Sério?

lines.text_source: I've ended up behind again. I knew I was taking too long.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Acabei ficando para trás novamente. Sabia que estava demorando demais.

lines.text_source: Well, I can't complain. It's been exciting, to be honest.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Bem, não posso reclamar. Foi emocionante, para ser sincera.

lines.text_source: What will you do now without that scientist of yours?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: inquire about next steps without scientist
lines.base_translation: O que você fará agora sem aquele cientista seu?
lines.risk_notes: references scientist (potential spoiler context); ensure 'that scientist' refers to absent ally without revealing fate

lines.text_source: Chief?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Chefe?

lines.text_source: We have no other choice, Baiyu. We'll stay here to find the cure for the braj and we'll take it to the Land of the Waterfalls.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: declare decision to stay and cure disease
lines.base_translation: Não temos outra escolha, Baiyu. Ficaremos aqui para encontrar a cura para o braj e a levaremos para a Terra das Cachoeiras.
lines.risk_notes: critical plot point (cure for braj, journey to Land of Waterfalls); ensure 'braj' remains untranslated per glossary protocol

lines.text_source: I suppose this is “goodbye”, then. Without Baydral, Hafin City is saved. The earthquakes have stopped and the dam will no longer burst.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Suponho que é 'adeus' então. Sem Baydral, Hafin está salva. Os terremotos cessaram e a barragem não mais arrebentará.
lines.risk_notes: major plot resolution (Baydral defeated, Hafin City saved, earthquakes stopped, dam no longer threatens); back-translation required to verify all lore details preserved accurately

lines.text_source: Will you be alright here?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vocês ficarão bem aqui?

lines.text_source: We spent so long thinking we were cursed. Once we arrived here, we discovered that Baydral, a legend in our world, had become twisted over the years, a recluse in this place, and that his “magic” was, in reality, science that turned us into horrible monsters.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: reveal truth about Baydral's corruption and nature of threat
lines.base_translation: Passamos tanto tempo pensando que estávamos amaldiçoados. Quando chegamos aqui, descobrimos que Baydral, uma lenda em nosso mundo, havia se tornado corrompido ao longo dos anos, um recluso neste lugar, e sua 'magia' era, na realidade, ciência que nos transformou em monstros horríveis.
lines.risk_notes: major revelation (Baydral legendary but corrupted; isolation; transformation victims; science vs magic); back-translation mandatory to ensure all exposition clear and lore-consistent; spoiler-laden but necessary climax disclosure

lines.text_source: It's not what we expected, but we've learnt a lot.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não é o que esperávamos, mas aprendemos muito.

lines.text_source: We'll stay here for a while and then Baiyu will take all these discoveries to our home.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ficaremos aqui um tempo e depois Baiyu levará todas essas descobertas para casa.

lines.text_source: Of course I will...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Claro que vou...

lines.text_source: Thank you for everything. You Humans aren't so bad.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Obrigado por tudo. Vocês humanos não são tão ruins.

lines.text_source: Thank you both.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: express gratitude to both party members
lines.base_translation: Obrigado a ambos.

lines.text_source: Well, thank you all, I'm feeling more capable by the minute. Take care.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: express gratitude and readiness to depart
lines.base_translation: Bem, obrigada a todos, estou me sentindo mais capaz a cada momento. Cuidem-se.

lines.text_source: Hey soldier, how about a race to Hafin? We've got good news to deliver!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: propose swift departure with good news
lines.base_translation: Ei soldado, que tal uma corrida até Hafin? Temos boas notícias para entregar!

lines.text_source: I'm sorry, it's not safe to enter Hafin's sewers due to the large number of monsters we've recently discovered there. Please be patient while we investigate.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Desculpe, não é seguro entrar nos esgotos de Hafin devido ao grande número de monstros que descobrimos lá recentemente. Tenha paciência enquanto investigamos.
